title: Accessibility Coding Guidelines
summary: Actionable coding guidelines for building accessible web applications, covering semantic HTML, focus management, forms, media, and testing. Use this skill when auditing or implementing accessibility features, keyboard navigation, or ARIA.

title: Accessible Error Announcement

title: Accessible generated content
summary: Use CSS generated content (`::before`/`::after`) in ways that stay accessible, including alternative text for decorative content.

title: Respect Operating System Text Scale
summary: Respect the operating system's text scale preference for a page so font sizes, layout, and rem-based measurements follow the user's accessibility settings.

title: Language Detection
summary: Detect the language of user-generated content or already present site content.

title: Language Model

title: Summarizer

title: Translator

title: Animate to Intrinsic Sizes

title: Conditionally Apply CSS Based on At-Rule Support

title: Calculate With Intrinsic Sizes

title: Child State Based Styling

title: Content Based Styling

Apply different styles when a condition is met, such as a custom property value on the element or an ancestor, a viewport size or user preference, or a numeric threshold.

title: CSS Layouts and Responsive Design
summary: Modern CSS layouts such as flexbox, grid, subgrid, container queries, anchor positioning, and intrinsic sizing. Use this skill when architecting responsive UI components or page layouts.

title: CSS: Modern Architecture
summary: Action-oriented guidelines for modern CSS architecture, including the cascade, selectors, scoping, nesting, and design tokens. Use this guide when authoring styles or managing design systems.

title: Design Token Reactivity

title: Styling siblings based on count and index

title: Fluid Scaling
summary: Scale items like font size, spacing, and media sizes smoothly based on the parent container's size rather than using fixed breakpoints

title: Individual Transform Properties

title: Masonry Layout

title: Overflow Clipping Control

title: Reduce Style Repetition with CSS Functions

title: Responsive design
summary: Build UI that adapts to container and viewport size, including container queries, dynamic viewport units, aspect ratios, and responsive typography.

title: Selector & @-rule Combinations
summary: Target elements based on the intersection or union of selectors and conditional @-rules while minimizing repetition.

title: Size Aware Styling
summary: Build a component whose styles can be conditionally dependent on its own width or height, rather than the width or height of the viewport. For example a card component that can change its layouts depending on how large it is, or a call-to-action button that can conditionally display helper text based on its width.

title: HTML

title: Calculating Event Differentials and Formatting Durations with Temporal

summary: Display and calculate dates in non-Gregorian calendar systems (e.g., Islamic, Hebrew, or Chinese) accurately for international users.

title: Avoid redundant large asset downloads

title: Debounce and batch multiple analytics events

title: Break Up Long Tasks

title: Calculate total foreground time

title: Conditional Async Dependencies

title: Defer rendering heavy content

title: Defer Work Until Scroll Ends

title: Deliver Optimized Decorative Images

title: Deprioritize background fetches

title: Detect Initial Visibility State

title: Efficient Background Processing

title: Faster SPA View Transitions via State Caching

title: Flicker-Free Client-Side A/B Testing

title: Reliably measure full-session analytics and telemetry
summary: Reliably track analytics, Core Web Vitals, errors, and telemetry data across the user's entire page visit, and defer sending of the data until the user leaves the page.

title: Identify heavy-running JavaScript
summary: Identify the scripts most responsible for long animation frames

title: Identify causes of poor INP

title: Improve next page load performance

title: Measure interaction and soft-navigation paint timing

title: Optimize preload priority

title: Share web fonts across origins

summary: Animate visual properties on a target element — such as fading a backdrop, shifting a background color, or to create scrollytelling experiences — driven entirely by the scrollport position of a completely different element.

title: Search hidden content
summary: Hide content from view using patterns such as accordions, tabs, and "Read more" sections, while ensuring the hidden text reveals itself during native "Find in page" searches, allows search engine indexing, supports URL fragment deep links, and maintains ARIA accessibility.

title: Sortable Table
summary: Progressively enhance a data table with behaviors that allow users to sort rows by clicking on column headers.

title: Spatial Navigation (Directional Keypad Focus)
summary: Implement accessible spatial navigation using arrow keys that works correctly in different layout modes (grid etc)

title: Swipe to remove
summary: Let users act on items in a list (remove, archive, mark as read, etc.) with a horizontal swipe gesture, so they can process entries quickly without tapping a separate control.

title: Swipe to reveal
summary: Let users swipe horizontally on a list item or content pane to reveal contextual action buttons or a side menu without automatically triggering an action.

title: Accordion
summary: Build an accordion component with animation, optional exclusive (one-open-at-a-time) behavior, and brand-consistent styling.

title: Build an application menu bar
summary: Build an application menu bar where several top-level menus (such as File, Edit, and View) act as a single keyboard stop and switch between each other on hover or arrow keys.

title: Build breadcrumbs
summary: Build a breadcrumb trail that shows the user's location within a site hierarchy and lets them navigate to ancestor pages.

title: Build a Card
summary: Build a card component that adapts its presentation to its own available space and contents.

title: Build a carousel
summary: Build a carousel component that displays a set of items in a horizontal or vertical layout.
Build a checkbox group for non-mutually exclusive multiple-choice selections with a master checkbox to (un)select all and brand-consistent styling.

title: Styling Checkboxes
summary: Style checkboxes, including custom icons, layout, colors, check/uncheck animations, while preserving native functionality and accessibility.
Build a content table component that displays tabular data with sortable columns, filterable rows, and selectable and editable cells.
Build a context menu component that displays a list of options or actions when users right-click or long-press on an element.

title: Copy button
summary: Build a copy button that copies text from arbitrary elements to the clipboard.

title: Dark mode toggles
summary: Build a dark mode toggle component that allows users to override their system color scheme preference for the current site.
Build a data grid / table with filterable rows, sortable columns, and selectable, editable cells.

title: Dialog
summary: Build a modal or non-modal dialog component that is accessible, manages focus appropriately, and can be dismissed the way users expect on each platform.

title: Build an interactive hovercard
summary: Build a hovercard component that displays an interactive structured preview of the page a certain type of link (e.g. a user profile) will navigate to when hovered over.

Build custom video or audio player controls and overlays—including play and pause toggles, scrubbing and volume bars, buffering indicators, captions, and picture-in-picture triggers—that stay synchronized with live playback state.

title: Build a popup menu

Behavior that only exists when several menus form one bar (one Tab stop, Left/Right between menus, preview on focus, hover switching) lives in app-menus. #}

title: Responsive Site Navigation
summary: Build a site navigation bar that adapts across screen sizes and indicates the current page.

title: Navigation Drawer
summary: Create a navigation drawer component that, when triggered from a menu button, slides in from the side overlaid on top of existing page content, and slides out when dismissed (by swiping away, tapping outside, or pressing escape).

title: Creating Persistent App Tours
summary: Create persistent onboarding walkthroughs using tethered native overlays that stay open during user interaction.

title: Creating Toast Notifications
summary: Create non-intrusive toast and overlay notifications for persistent, stackable messaging and state communication.

title: Progress ring
summary: Build a progress ring component that visually represents the completion status of a task or process, with support for content in the center and brand-consistent styling.

title: Build a Styled Progress Bar
summary: Build a styled progress bar that communicates completion of a task or process, in both determinate and indeterminate states.

title: Build a Scrollspy Navigation
summary: Highlight the currently visible section of a page in a navigation menu
Build skeleton placeholders that reserve space for loading content, improving perceived performance, reducing layout shifts and respecting reduced-motion preferences.

title: Loading spinner
summary: Build a loading spinner that communicates busy state to all users, respects reduced-motion preferences, and animates efficiently.

title: Stack Drill Down
summary: Build full-screen hierarchical navigation that lets users drill down into nested views and swipe or navigate back to return, with browser history kept in sync.

title: Tabbed interfaces
summary: Build a responsive tabbed interface with good UX when not all tabs fit on screen.

title: Build a toolbar
summary: Build a toolbar component that displays a set of controls for performing actions.

title: Maximize content and reduce noise
summary: Maximize content and reduce noise by removing blocking popups, keeping persistent navigation compact, and moving secondary content behind on-demand disclosure.

title: Adapt to the form factor
summary: Adapt layouts, controls, and text to any device or container so touch targets stay usable, content fits its space, and nothing collides with system UI.
Provide fast, guided navigation between views that avoids full-page reloads, preserves scroll and input state, and uses directional transitions.

title: Implement natural interactions
summary: Implement natural interactions with clear hover, focus, and press feedback, motion that opens from its trigger, swipeable content, and keyboard-reachable actions.
Respect the user's color theme, reduced motion, locale, and data-saving preferences, and keep working when the connection is slow or offline.

title: Adapt scrollbar to high-contrast preferences
summary: Enhance scrollbar visibility for users who prefer high-contrast interfaces

summary: Apply custom visual effects with WebGL shaders to HTML content.

summary: Theme browser-generated UI such as text selection, scrollbars, form controls, and pickers with CSS instead of re-creating it with custom elements.
Dynamically generate aesthetically pleasing tints and shades from a base color, e.g. to be used in borders or hover and focus states.

title: Color
summary: Color guidance for the web, including contrast requirements, light and dark color schemes, Forced Colors Mode, and generating tints and shades from a base color.

title: Complex Shapes
summary: Clip elements and their content to any free-form shape, like a symbol, brush stroke, or organic texture for more expressive designs.

summary: Select a readable text color with sufficient contrast on a dynamic background color.

summary: Make every line of a multi-line heading or lockup span the same width, as in poster-style or stacked-headline typography. Unlike justified text, the text itself is sized to the width rather than the spacing stretched

title: Export HTML content from canvas
summary: Capture and export dynamic HTML content as images or video frames from within canvas.

title: Expose canvas content to browser features
summary: Expose content rendered in a canvas to browser features like assistive technologies, translation, or reading mode.

title: Fit text to container width
summary: Make text always fit its container's width, e.g. a card headline that fills the full width on one line at any size, or a long title that fits instead of overflowing or wrapping

title: Gradient Borders
summary: Create continuous gradient borders around an element, with a transparent content area and optionally an animation

title: Improve Text Layout and Legibility
summary: Improve the layout and legibility of short standalone text content, such as headings no longer than a few lines, by enabling the browser to apply evenly balanced line breaks when wrapping text.

title: Enable interactive HTML content in 3D scenes
summary: Integrate interactive HTML elements into a 3D scene.

title: Precise Text Alignment
summary: Achieve precise vertical alignment with text of any font. For example, exactly equal visual padding above and below text, or aligning text perfectly flush with adjacent icons or images.

title: Shaped Cutouts
summary: Combine multiple shapes to create complex cutouts or 'knockout' effects in elements, such as adding a notch to an element.

title: Soft Edge Content Fade
summary: Apply a transparency gradient to content edges to indicate further scrollable areas or to obscure payment-walled text.

title: Typography
summary: Typography best practices for the web, including font sizing units, line height, text wrapping and balancing, and fluid type that scales with the viewport.

title: Visual effects

title: Visually Stable Font Fallbacks
summary: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in the event that there's a swap between the preferred font and one of the fallbacks (or vice versa).

title: Visually Stable Mixed Fonts
summary: Define font styles such that text remains readable and visually consistent in situations where multiple fonts are used to render a single block of text.

title: Visually Texture Content
summary: Apply realistic weathering and texture patterns to elements to give them an organic, aged, or physical material appearance.
